subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
4. 
Mr. Raj is confident that investment made by him is completely secure 
and there is no risk of any loss. Select the correct statement in this 
regards: 
(a) 
Audited Financial statements provide absolute assurance therefore 
money invested by Mr. Raj is absolutely safe. 
(b) 
Audited Financial statements provide reasonable assurance. It 
doesn't guarantee complete accuracy.  
(c) 
Neither (a) nor (b) is correct. 
(d) 
Both (a) and (b) are correct.
